purpose: Consciously illustrated fictional adult scenes replace photographic simulations. These are not documentary photographs or real interviewees.

assets.prompt: Create a sophisticated hand-drawn editorial illustration for an adult beginner English coursebook, intentionally illustrated, never a simulated photograph. Landscape 3:2 composition. A second-hand clothing shop with two adult friends standing side by side, visible from full head to mid-thigh. LEFT: Nia, a woman with brown skin and short dark curls, wears a simple GREEN DRESS and a YELLOW HAT and is clearly looking down at a paper leaflet held in both hands. RIGHT: Eli, a man with medium brown skin and short dark hair, wears a BLUE JACKET over a WHITE T-SHIRT and BLUE JEANS; he touches the lapel of his jacket with one hand while looking toward his friend. Both adult ordinary proportions. Keep the exact clothing colors unmistakable, heads and gesture hands complete. A few simple second-hand coats and a rail in the background, with believable useful shop context, not busy. Modern print illustration with bold but restrained opaque gouache shapes, fine irregular ink contours, visible paper texture and natural small asymmetries; expressive human faces with minimal well-observed features, not glossy 3D, not vector clipart, no airbrush, no photoreal skin, not children’s cartoon. Palette: deep ultramarine, bottle green, mustard, warm charcoal and unbleached paper; warm red tiny environmental detail permitted. No text, lettering, logos, price tags with writing, captions, labels or watermark. No border or panel divisions. Leave a quiet narrow lower strip for live HTML character names, do not render those names.

A single wide 2:1 editorial gouache-and-ink illustration for an adult English coursebook, a deliberately hand-drawn contemporary print illustration, not photorealistic and not childlike. Show EXACTLY THREE separate ordinary adults in a quiet town park with a bench, three equally clear full figures, complete heads/hair/feet and the hands doing each action. LEFT PERSON 1: an adult woman with dark curly hair STANDS READING AN OPEN BOOK, wearing a RED knitted sweater, dark BLUE JEANS and WHITE SHOES. Absolutely NO HAT on her head. MIDDLE PERSON 2: an adult man with short straight dark hair SITS ON THE BENCH DRINKING FROM A WHITE CUP, wearing a WHITE T-SHIRT, BLACK JEANS, WHITE SHOES and a conspicuous YELLOW brimmed HAT. Absolutely no jacket. RIGHT PERSON 3: an adult woman with long brown hair STANDS TALKING ON A MOBILE PHONE held to her ear, wearing a GREEN sleeveless knee-length DRESS, WHITE SHOES and carrying a BROWN SHOULDER BAG. Absolutely NO HAT on her head. The educational evidence must be exact: only middle person has a hat; left reads; middle drinks; right calls; all clothing colors distinct. Keep hands/cup/book/phone large and unmistakable. Natural believable ordinary adult proportions, modest bodies, calm expressions, lively observed posture. Low simplified bench and trees supply full setting, not three separate panels or a blank backdrop. Rich opaque color with fine slightly irregular ink edges, subtle paper grain, forms built from flat gouache planes, restrained shadow. Deep green tree silhouettes, warm paper highlights and charcoal outlines harmonize. No writing, numbers, letters, brand marks, captions, watermark or graphic borders. Leave small quiet spaces near feet for live HTML number markers.

Two-panel editorial portrait illustration for an adult English coursebook audio show about online shopping. A wide landscape 2:1 diptych, exactly two equal square panels and a very narrow white center gutter. Consciously illustrated with sophisticated opaque gouache shapes, slightly irregular fine ink lines, warm paper grain, not photorealism, not a 3D render, not a children’s cartoon. Left panel: fictional adult woman Mina, medium brown skin, straight dark shoulder-length hair and a cream blouse, smiling and holding up a conspicuously large BLUE fabric tote bag beside an open cardboard delivery box on a plain home table. She wants to keep the bag because it is big enough for her notebook. Right panel: a different fictional adult woman Tess, warm brown skin, shoulder-length curly dark hair and a conspicuously ORANGE jacket she is trying on at home. Jacket obviously too large, shoulder seams dropped and loose sleeves cover part of her hands; she looks thoughtfully at one overlong sleeve with mild concern. Head-to-hip close framing with entire heads, hands and bag/jacket evidence inside the panels at equal meaningful scale. Normal ordinary adult proportions, expressive well-observed minimal faces, restrained natural poses, simple cream/gray home backgrounds with a few quieter objects. Use deep blue and warm orange as the unmistakable teaching colors. NO labels, written text, letters, numerals, captions, price marks, brands, logos or watermark. Photographic realism is specifically not wanted; make this look like commissioned human editorial artwork.

A wide adult English coursebook editorial illustration contact sheet with FOUR EQUAL VERTICAL PANELS in one horizontal row, overall approximately 3:1. Consciously hand-illustrated in the same modern opaque gouache-and-fine-ink print language, warm paper grain, rich but restrained natural colors. Not photorealistic, no fake glossy skin, no 3D/cartoon effect. Four DIFFERENT clear shopping actions, left to right: PANEL A adult woman at a home table PAYING ONLINE, holds bank card beside an open laptop with blank screen, complete hands visible; PANEL B adult man TRYING ON a dark red jacket at a shop mirror, adjusting the lapels, complete head and hands visible; PANEL C adult woman at home who is KEEPING her new cream sweater, holding it up with a pleased expression and a clear thumbs-up beside an empty opened delivery box; PANEL D adult man RETURNING a closed brown parcel across a parcel-service counter to a clerk, both people’s transfer hands visible. Keep every educational action clear and whole inside its panel. Medium-close head/torso framing at consistent meaningful scale with clean quiet but useful home/shop/counter contexts. Exact equal panel widths, narrow white gutters, no overlap between panels. Distinct clothes/colors across panels. No text, no letters including A/B/C/D, no numerals, no labels, no brands, no readable screens, no price marks, no captions, no watermark. This is intended to look like commissioned adult editorial artwork with observed human gestures and tactile materials.

One intentionally hand-drawn editorial character cutout for an adult English coursebook recipe-planning task. A fictional ordinary adult woman, warm brown skin and short curly dark hair, wearing a simple WHITE T-SHIRT, a deep forest GREEN APRON, dark trousers and plain comfortable white shoes. She stands calmly holding a medium salad bowl with recognizable red tomato pieces in one hand at waist height and a wooden mixing spoon in the other, looking at the bowl thoughtfully. Show her full head, entire hands, complete apron, both whole shoes; natural modest adult proportions. Deliberately illustrated with opaque gouache planes, fine irregular charcoal-ink contours and subtly tactile paper grain. Rich observed forms and human expression, sophisticated contemporary editorial illustration, not a children’s cartoon, not a photoreal portrait, no glossy skin, no 3D/airbrush. Keep tomato bowl and spoon plainly recognizable and her silhouette clean. Genuine transparent alpha background, no wall, room, floor plane, shadow rectangle, gradient, sticker border or halo. Portrait proportion, efficient figure placement with modest transparent margins but no cropped shoes/hair. No writing, numbers, letters, captions, logos or watermark. This is fictional teaching art, not a real cook’s portrait.
